models_evaluated: AI-integrated non-mydriatic fundus camera DR screening model

links.outcome: AI referable DR detection accuracy versus gold standard human grading in local clinics
links.quote: The accuracy of the AI grading was assessed against gold standard human grading.

links.outcome: AI performance in real-world clinic use conditions across five sites
links.effect: In real-world primary care and endocrinology clinics, AI achieved 93.3% accuracy, with 86% of patients and 85% of care providers highly satisfied.
links.quote: The AI-assisted DR screening model was accurate and well received by patients and staff in Australian primary care and endocrinology clinics.

screen.reason: Pragmatic clinical trial evaluating the diagnostic accuracy, feasibility, and patient/clinician satisfaction of an AI-based diabetic retinopathy screening system in primary care and endocrinology clinics.
